purpose: Publicly cleared current-native motion example, not a quality-tuning comparison or independent-user verification.
pipeline: Unchanged native_motion_backend.prepare/render called directly, same current app modules; not an HTTP/browser test.
pre_gpu_gate: Inspect actual prepared pose/face crops. Require one continuous recognizable body, visibly plausible raising-arm control and usable face crop. No parameter repairs/retry after failure.
quality_review: Retain every raw frame and composite separately, compare original/prepared reference and source. Existing broad motion/reference/stability/shape/rendering anchors>=3 and no collapse. Additional exact-face judgement remains unproved if resolution/view insufficient; do not declare memory or realistic generalization.
stopping_rule: One CPU call<=900s; one GPU call<=900s only after controls pass. $1 included total; cash0. Stop technical or quality failure; no automatic retries, model changes, seed searches or held-out claim.
